subject.title: Add an official Featherless AI provider plugin

question: Should Featherless become an official OpenClaw external provider package now, or remain a custom-provider/community path until live proof and package reservation are complete?
rationale: The code path exists for official external providers, but promoting a new provider package changes supported onboarding, auth flags, docs, catalog metadata, and release ownership.

options.title: Proceed through linked PR
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101092 after live Featherless text/tool-call proof and package-publish timing are confirmed.

options.title: Defer official status
options.body: Leave users on generic custom-provider configuration or a community ClawHub package until demand or proof justifies official package ownership.

options.title: Narrow to docs first
options.body: Document the custom-provider setup path now and revisit official packaging separately when maintainer ownership is ready.

recommendation.title: Proceed through linked PR
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101092 after live Featherless text/tool-call proof and package-publish timing are confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns this issue, the linked draft PR, and recent analogous provider-package work.
